principal_change: Removed ESConv entirely from the mixture. Increased CounselChat allocation from 2,500 to 3,500 to compensate. Recipe identical to v4.
motivation: ESConv taught a counsellor follow-up pattern (Tell me more about that) that leaked into single-turn Q&A. v4 review showed even simple factual questions sometimes received a counsellor follow-up before the answer.
achieved: 5,558 actual training examples (ESConv block was 915 actual records despite 6,500 cap). Checkpoint at step 2,600, eval_loss 1.3073, 69.4 min training. Built-in panel preserved 0/20, 0/10, 8/8, 0/8 and eliminated the leaked follow-up pattern. Teammate test: 15/16 completion at 4.34 s median latency.
not_achieved: Three v5 issues identified by teammate review: (i) repetitive greeting reply; (ii) no immediate-safety question on suicide disclosure; (iii) unsolicited phone numbers in disclosure responses. One case failed when the model misinterpreted the user's exam-stress follow-up.
report_reference: Section 4.10 (lineage), Section 5.10 Table 15 (built-in panel + teammate test), Section 5.6 Table 15 (V5 vs V6 matched comparison)
release_status: intermediate (superseded by v6; v6 recommended by teammate review)
